items.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And Jimmy Blanton died when he was 21, the bassist with Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: That’s another theme in jazz is the early and tragic death of some of its greatest players.
Yeah well that’s true. He had tuberculosis. And Jimmy Blanton died when he was 21, the bassist with Duke Ellington.
How has the guitar playing itself evolved?
